name: t3code-mods
description: Mod loader for T3 Code: customize the app with mods you turn on and off, write and share, without a fork. Not affiliated with T3 Code.

scripts.build:tsx-demo: bun build examples/tsx-demo/src/index.tsx --outfile examples/tsx-demo/renderer.js --format esm --target browser --external react --external react/* --external react-dom --external react-dom/*
